name: Zovo Love Story Poster
original_description:
Turn the day you met, your first date or your wedding day into a keepsake "our story in numbers" poster. Zovo Love Story Poster counts how many days you have been together using calendar math (real month lengths and leap years), and adds the years, months and days, the weeks, the full months, the hours (with clock changes when you give a time zone), the full moons you have seen together, the weekends, the leap days and the anniversaries.

It also works out when your next round milestones fall: the 1,000th day, 500 weeks, 100 months, 100,000 hours, the 100th full moon, a billion seconds and the next anniversary, each with its date. Ask "when is our 1,000th day?" or "when is our 100th day?" (Korean-style counting, where the first day is day 1, is available).

Downloads: a printable portrait poster PDF in Letter, A4, A3 or 12 x 18 inches with four colour themes, and a calendar file (ICS) for Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar that reminds you a week before each milestone.

Good for anniversary gifts, wedding anniversaries, Valentine's Day, friendship anniversaries and family milestones.

Limitations: one start date per poster; the start date cannot be in the future (for a countdown to an event, use a countdown tool); dates from 1900 onward; full moon dates are in UTC unless a time zone is given; no photos.
